rationale: The agent located a user by name and ZIP and pulled several orders, but then executed a return on order #W9571698 for four items with refund to a gift card. This violates multiple requirements: (1) it did not confirm with the user before performing an order-changing write; (2) it refunded to a gift card without first attempting or verifying the impossibility of a credit card refund, contrary to the user’s primary request; (3) it returned multiple items (likely the whole order) instead of just the more expensive tablet, without explicit user confirmation that the fallback path should be used; and (4) it did not provide clear final information confirming what was done. While there was some level of identification via name+ZIP, the critical failures are the unconfirmed write and not following the requested refund method and scope of return. Therefore, the interaction fails the policy-aligned completion bar.
